request.text:
The source records that this same-type predecessor cannot be defined
without the selection operator, deriving this from the independence of the
axiom of infinity, which in its \S4 is Axioms~7 and~8 taken together
\cite[\S2, p.~59; \S4, p.~61]{Church1940}; the claim is reported without
proof (\cref{def:p02-w02-p02-041-church-predecessor}).
request.reason: Corrects the attributed standing: the source (printed p. 59) cites the independence of the axiom of infinity, which p. 61 identifies with Axioms 7 and 8 together, not Axiom 8 alone; marks the claim as an unproved source claim.
